tws.name: Trident Wire Service
tws.owner: Non-profit member cooperative of 340 subscriber newspapers
tws.funding: Subscriber fees. No single member holds more than 2% of voting stock.
tws.corrections: Public corrections log. 41 corrections issued in the last 12 months, average 3.1 hours after publication.
tws.policy: Two-source rule for all breaking claims. Anonymous sources require editor sign-off and a stated reason for anonymity.
tws.tell: Hedges early numbers. Uses datelines. Names its sources or says exactly why it cannot.

herald.name: The Pacific Herald
herald.corrections: Corrections page, print and web. 88 corrections in the last 12 months.
herald.policy: Investigative desk of 22. Strong document sourcing. Slower than the wires by design.
herald.tell: Deep and usually right, but its analysis outruns its evidence when it is chasing the wire.

cbn.name: Continental Broadcasting Network
cbn.funding: Licence fee and direct government appropriation. Board appointed by the Ministry of Information.
cbn.corrections: No public corrections log. Stories are silently updated in place.
cbn.policy: Editorial guidelines require 'consideration of national interest' during declared emergencies.
cbn.tell: Rarely prints anything false. Watch what it leaves out, not what it says.

signal.name: The Signal Post
signal.owner: Signal Post Media Ltd. (Registered offshore, beneficial ownership not disclosed.)
signal.funding: Programmatic advertising. Revenue scales with pageviews.
signal.tell: Fastest to publish, loosest with numbers. Almost always sourced to 'officials' who are never named.

straitwatch.name: @straitwatch
straitwatch.owner: Anonymous individual. Claims to be a former marine traffic analyst.
straitwatch.corrections: Corrects openly and quickly in-thread. Also deletes posts without note.
straitwatch.policy: Publishes raw AIS and satellite data and lets readers argue. No editor.
straitwatch.tell: Often first and often right on technical detail. Also the source of the two worst rumours of the last crisis.

lotus.name: WHITE LOTUS
lotus.corrections: Has never issued one. Has never needed to.
lotus.tell: Appears on this desk without a submission record. The technical team has not been able to explain how.
